sounds.name: Stagger Cascade
sounds.desc: A quick roll of soft pops climbing in pitch from left to right, the last one ringing slightly. For staggered lists, chips and words appearing one by one.

sounds.name: Checkbox
sounds.desc: A bright two-note pluck when a box is checked and a short muted drop when it is cleared.

sounds.name: Crisp Click
sounds.desc: A dry, snappy click for primary buttons: a bandpassed noise transient over a stiff triangle tick, gone in 30 ms.

sounds.name: Deep Click
sounds.desc: A low, padded thock for heavy buttons and primary actions: a falling sine body with a soft knock on top.

sounds.name: Glass Click
sounds.desc: A bright, glassy tick for buttons: a few high inharmonic partials with a short ring, light and clean.

sounds.name: Soft Click
sounds.desc: A short muted tick for button presses: a falling sine blip with a breath of high noise.

sounds.name: Wooden Click
sounds.desc: A warm wooden knock for buttons: a short damped block tone with a dull knuckle thud, calm enough to repeat all day.

sounds.name: Copy to Clipboard
sounds.desc: A quick rising scoop and a bright ping to confirm a copy to the clipboard.

sounds.name: Delete to Trash
sounds.desc: A short paper crumple that drops into a bin with a dull thud, for deleting or discarding an item.

sounds.name: Drag Drop
sounds.desc: A soft landing thud for dropping an item on its target, with an optional small bounce as it settles.

sounds.name: Drag Pickup
sounds.desc: A soft lift for grabbing an item to drag: a small grip tick and a short rising breath.

sounds.name: Drop Zone
sounds.desc: A drop zone for files: a soft rising breath when a file hovers over it, and a gulp, a low thunk and a small settle pip when it lands.

sounds.name: Expand and Collapse
sounds.desc: A quick stepped run of soft blips: rising when a section expands, falling and a touch quieter when it collapses.

sounds.name: Submenu Flyout
sounds.desc: A short, bright puff and pip for a submenu or nested context menu opening beside its parent; closing falls and ends in a soft tick.

sounds.name: Focus Ring
sounds.desc: A soft pip with a few fading echoes for keyboard focus landing on a control, like a ring spreading outward.

sounds.name: Hover Tick
sounds.desc: A barely-there high tick for the pointer entering a button or row. Very quiet, meant to repeat.

sounds.name: Light Keypress
sounds.desc: A light, quiet keypress for typing: a soft thump and tap that varies a little each press; size reaches the spacebar.

sounds.name: Mechanical Keypress
sounds.desc: A mechanical keyboard keypress: a bright click, a bottom-out thock and a faint release tick, different every time.

sounds.name: Radial Fan
sounds.desc: A quick fan of small pips round a ring for a radial menu or speed-dial opening, one per petal; closing folds back down.

sounds.name: Menu Slide
sounds.desc: An airy slide for a menu or drawer opening (rising, soft landing) and closing (falling, latch tick); size runs from dropdown to drawer.

sounds.name: Modal Open and Close
sounds.desc: A soft low swell for a dialog opening, with a small glint on arrival, and a quick falling sigh for it closing.

sounds.name: Page Turn
sounds.desc: A paper page turned: a soft sweep of air, light rustles and a quiet landing. For pagers, carousels and readers.

sounds.name: Palette Open
sounds.desc: A quick upward glide into a small glassy ring for a command palette or search overlay opening; closing slips back down.

sounds.name: Keypad Key
sounds.desc: A soft two-tone press for a PIN pad or numeric keypad, different for each digit; the last digit can add a small rising confirm.

sounds.name: Pulse Beat
sounds.desc: One soft lub-dub heartbeat. Re-trigger every 0.8 s at 72 bpm (60 divided by the rate) for a live dot or pulsing badge.

sounds.name: Radio Select
sounds.desc: A soft rounded bloop for picking one option from a group: a sine that bends upward over a quiet low body.

sounds.name: Star Rating
sounds.desc: A run of rising glassy pings, one per star, for rating something; five stars add a small glint on top.

sounds.name: Record Toggle
sounds.desc: Two short blips and a longer beep when recording starts, and one long falling tone when it stops.

sounds.name: Scroll Detent
sounds.desc: A tiny dry wooden tick for one notch of a scroll wheel or picker; raise ticks for a quick flick through several.

sounds.name: Shake No
sounds.desc: A soft two-note "uh-uh" that swings left and right. For a field that shakes, a refused input or a polite no.

sounds.name: Sheet Snap
sounds.desc: A weighty drawer or bottom sheet sliding in and snapping into place with a small rebound; closing drops away with a soft thud.

sounds.name: Slider Detent
sounds.desc: A small pitched tick for a slider thumb crossing a notch; set pos from the thumb position and a drag climbs a scale.

sounds.name: Spring Settle
sounds.desc: A quiet wobbling tone that overshoots, swings up and down and settles to rest. For springy, elastic and jelly motion.

sounds.name: Rubber Stamp
sounds.desc: A rubber stamp landing on paper: a firm thump, a flat slap and a wet splat of ink, then a soft peel as it lifts. For approved, paid or verified.

sounds.name: Step Advance
sounds.desc: One soft rounded note per step, each higher on a gentle scale, landing with a small knock. Reaching the last step adds a bell glint on top.

sounds.name: Number Stepper
sounds.desc: A tiny pip for the plus and minus of a number stepper: it hops up when the value rises and down when it falls.

sounds.name: Tab Switch
sounds.desc: A short airy slide with a tiny landing pip for a tab, pill or segment taking the selection; the pitch follows where it lands.

sounds.name: Tap
sounds.desc: A soft fingertip tap for touch screens and list rows: a muffled pat over a short mid thud, rounder than a click.

sounds.name: Task Done
sounds.desc: A pen tick, a quick strike-through swipe and a small ding for a task crossed off. A streak adds a trail of rising glints.

sounds.name: Toggle Switch
sounds.desc: A two-stage click-clack for switches: rising when turned on, falling when turned off.

sounds.name: Tooltip Pop
sounds.desc: A tiny glassy bubble pop for a tooltip or popover appearing: a bright pip that bends up and settles.

sounds.name: Typewriter Return
sounds.desc: A typewriter carriage return: a ratcheting slide, a knock at the stop and a bright margin bell. For typed lines finishing and retro text effects.

sounds.name: Undo
sounds.desc: A short rewind flutter that falls and settles with a soft tick, for undoing the last action.

sounds.name: Field Verdict
sounds.desc: Two quick pips stepping up for a valid field, two short buzzing pips stepping down for an invalid one. Light enough to play on every keystroke check.

sounds.name: Directional Wipe
sounds.desc: A quiet band of air that sweeps across from one side to the other and lands with a tiny tick. For wipes, curtains, shutters and irises uncovering content.

sounds.name: Achievement Unlocked
sounds.desc: A quick rising run into a warm bell chord with a few glints. A small celebration for something earned.

sounds.name: Gentle Alarm
sounds.desc: Soft rounded beeps in rising pairs that swell round by round. Wakes you without startling you.

sounds.name: Badge Pop
sounds.desc: One tiny bubbly pop for a badge count going up, with a fainter echo pop behind it. Each count is a step higher on a gentle scale.

sounds.name: Banner Drop
sounds.desc: A weighted slide and a soft thud for a banner dropping in, with a low bong for an alert or a rising pair for an all-clear. It lifts out with a light slide and a latch tick.

sounds.name: Calendar Event
sounds.desc: A tiny page-flip tick and two soft plucked notes rising a fourth. An event is starting; warm and organized, not urgent.

sounds.name: Critical Alarm
sounds.desc: Two or three hard buzzing stabs, each higher than the last, over a shuddering low rumble. Unmistakably urgent, and over in under a second.

sounds.name: Attention Double Tap
sounds.desc: Two soft wooden knocks, each a touch lower and quieter. A gentle "excuse me" that is barely a sound.

sounds.name: Download Complete
sounds.desc: A soft downward glide that settles with a gentle thump and a small ting. The file is in place.

sounds.name: Error Buzz
sounds.desc: A low falling double buzz for a rejected action. Clear without being harsh.

sounds.name: Incoming Call Ring
sounds.desc: A short bell-like phone ring: bursts of fast alternating notes with a pause between. Loops cleanly if you repeat it.

sounds.name: Info Ping
sounds.desc: One soft bell tap for neutral news: nothing wrong and nothing won, just a heads-up. Made to be heard all day.

sounds.name: Low Battery
sounds.desc: Three slow falling notes under a closing filter, the last one sagging. Power is running out.

sounds.name: Mention Ping
sounds.desc: A quick grace note into a glassy bell ting with a soft echo. Stands out from ordinary messages without shouting.

sounds.name: Message Received
sounds.desc: Two quick bubbly pops rising a fourth, like a chat bubble arriving. Friendly and short enough for a busy channel.

sounds.name: Message Sent
sounds.desc: A soft rising whoosh into a tiny blip: your message is on its way. Quiet enough to play on every send.

sounds.name: New Mail
sounds.desc: A soft falling swish into a short-long two-bell "tu-ding". A letter has landed in the inbox.

sounds.name: Presence Change
sounds.desc: Two soft bell notes rising for someone coming online, one lower note sagging away for going offline. Gentle enough for a long contact list.

sounds.name: Reminder Chime
sounds.desc: A soft two-bell "ding-dong" with a little room around it. A polite nudge that something is due.

sounds.name: Success Chime
sounds.desc: A gentle two-note rising chime for a completed action. Not a fanfare; a quiet yes.

sounds.name: Sync Done
sounds.desc: A quick back-and-forth of two notes that settles on the octave. Everything is in step again.

sounds.name: Task Failed
sounds.desc: A run of low falling buzzes that sags on the last one. Something you were waiting on did not work out; firm, not harsh.

sounds.name: Toast Arrive
sounds.desc: A quick side swish that lands on a small tick and a short tone for the severity: a soft ping, a rising pair, a falling pair, a low buzz or three urgent stabs.

sounds.name: Toast Dismiss
sounds.desc: A quick falling swipe and a soft pat for a toast sliding away. With the drain on, a few small ticks run out first, for toasts that dismiss themselves.

sounds.name: Upload Complete
sounds.desc: A soft upward glide that lands on a bright chime note. The file has arrived.

sounds.name: Warning Tone
sounds.desc: A two-note falling "uh-oh" in a round triangle tone. Cautions without scolding; milder than the error buzz.

sounds.name: Bar Rise
sounds.desc: A staggered run of soft marimba ticks, one per bar, each as high in pitch as the bar is tall. For bar charts drawing in.

sounds.name: Count-Up Roll
sounds.desc: A run of small ticks that speeds up, brakes and lands on a soft thunk, climbing in pitch: for a big number counting up to its value.

sounds.name: Counter Tick
sounds.desc: A tiny tick for one step of a number: set value from the count and a run of steps climbs in pitch. Glassy at one end, a dry wheel click at the other.

sounds.name: Delta Tick
sounds.desc: A tiny two-note chirp for a number that changed: rising when it went up, falling when it went down.

sounds.name: Failover
sounds.desc: A dull falling thud as a node goes down, a short silence, then a rising run of three notes as the backup takes over. For high availability and recovery diagrams.

sounds.name: Fan-out
sounds.desc: One blip arrives and splits into a fan of blips that fly out across the stereo field, left to right, each a step higher. For a load balancer or a broadcast.

sounds.name: Gauge Needle
sounds.desc: A small servo whir as a gauge needle swings to a new reading, a few springy bounces, then a soft detent tick as it settles.

sounds.name: Heat Bloom
sounds.desc: A soft cluster of tiny grains that swells and fades like a heat map filling in. Higher warmth is brighter and hotter.

sounds.name: Line Draw
sounds.desc: A soft tone glides along a line as it is drawn, rising or falling with its trend, and glitters where the line arrives.

sounds.name: Link Up / Down
sounds.desc: Link up is two quick blips and a soft settling note, a handshake that worked. Link down plays the blips falling and then sinks away.

sounds.name: Liquid Fill
sounds.desc: Water glugging into a vessel with a pitch that climbs as the level rises. For tanks, batteries, thermometers and filling gauges.

sounds.name: Wait Resolved
sounds.desc: A quick filled sweep that lands with a soft settle and a small check tick, for a spinner or skeleton that has finished. Quieter than a success chime.

sounds.name: Load Pulse
sounds.desc: A soft slow breath of sound for a loader that keeps waiting. One breath per play: re-trigger every 0.9 s (or at the breath length you set).

sounds.name: Log Tail
sounds.desc: A short burst of tiny typed blips, one run per log line, higher and edgier from debug to error. Re-trigger every 1.5 s while a log streams.

sounds.name: Monitor Beep
sounds.desc: One clean beep of a patient monitor, with an optional soft heartbeat under it. Re-trigger every 0.8 s for 75 beats per minute.

sounds.name: Nixie Strike
sounds.desc: A glassy snap and a fizz of sparks as a nixie tube lights, then a warm electrical hum that swells and fades: for a retro digit appearing.

sounds.name: Packet Hop
sounds.desc: A tiny blip hops from node to node, climbing a scale step per hop as it crosses the stereo field, and lands with a soft tick. Quiet enough to fire every few hundred milliseconds.

sounds.name: Pin Drop
sounds.desc: A map pin drops onto its spot with a quick falling swish, a soft landing tap, a glassy tink and a small bounce. For a marker appearing on a map.

sounds.name: Progress Fill
sounds.desc: A short rising glide whose note follows the progress: call it on every update with pos from 0 to 1 and the updates draw one climbing line.

sounds.name: Request / Response
sounds.desc: A short rising blip goes out, a pause for the latency, and a soft two-note chime comes back. For an API call, a DNS lookup or any request with a reply.

sounds.name: Route Trace
sounds.desc: A soft rising glide with a small glass tick at each waypoint and a bell where the trip ends. For a dot or vehicle travelling a route on a map.

sounds.name: Scale Out / In
sounds.desc: Scaling out piles up a run of rising blips into a chord, scaling in drops a run of short blips down and away. For auto scaling, capacity and fleet size changes.

sounds.name: Sonar Ping
sounds.desc: One clean sonar ping that fades into a few softer, darker echoes. For a you-are-here marker, an accuracy ring or an outage ripple spreading from a point.

sounds.name: Sort Swap
sounds.desc: Rows trading places: crossing glides, a pair of landing ticks and a quiet slide. Raise swaps for a longer sort.

sounds.name: Spinner Ticks
sounds.desc: A soft ring of ticks that turns once per play, circling from side to side. Re-trigger every 1.0 s (or at the turn time you set) for a steady spinner.

sounds.name: Flap Clack
sounds.desc: A rolling clatter of hinged cards falling, character by character, each landing on a firmer clack: for a split-flap board or flip clock changing.

sounds.name: Threshold Cross
sounds.desc: Two pips as a meter crosses a line: a soft rising pair for green, a repeated note for amber, a rough falling pair for red.

sounds.name: Denoise
sounds.desc: A haze of static that narrows and sweeps down until it settles into one clean tone. An image or an answer coming into focus.

sounds.name: Guardrail Verdict
sounds.desc: A check on what an AI is about to do: a small clear ding when it is allowed, a dull thud with a short low buzz when it is blocked.

sounds.name: Agent Handoff
sounds.desc: A single note slides from one side to the other and changes voice on the way, from a warm tone to a glassy ring. One agent handing the work to the next.

sounds.name: Reasoning Step
sounds.desc: A soft glassy note that slides up from the last one and echoes twice. Each step climbs one note of a gentle scale, so a chain of thought rises as it goes.

sounds.name: Retrieval Sweep
sounds.desc: A quick run of rising glassy glints, faster as they climb, that settles on one clear ping. A knowledge lookup finding its match.

sounds.name: Stream Done
sounds.desc: A small tock as the cursor stops, then a soft two-note glass chime falling to rest. For the end of a streamed reply or a finished generation.

sounds.name: Thinking Hum
sounds.desc: A warm, quiet breath of sound for an assistant that is working: one soft swell that fades to silence. Re-trigger every 1.4 s for as long as it thinks.

sounds.name: Token Stream
sounds.desc: A fast patter of tiny glassy pips on an uneven beat, like a reply streaming in word by word. Machine text, not a keyboard.

sounds.name: Tool Call
sounds.desc: A small blip as a request goes out, a short wait, then the answer: a clear glass ding when the call works, a soft low drop when it fails.

sounds.name: Typing Dots
sounds.desc: Three soft rising bloops in a row, like the dots of a typing indicator. Re-trigger every 1.2 s while the other side is writing.

sounds.name: Arrow Shot
sounds.desc: A bowstring twang and the zip of an arrow leaving. For archers and ranged attacks.

sounds.name: Bounce
sounds.desc: A rubbery boing: a quick spring up, then a wobble that settles. For jump pads, springs and balls.

sounds.name: Checkpoint
sounds.desc: A soft thump and three bells fanning up that ring together: progress saved. Warmer than a success chime.

sounds.name: Coin Flip
sounds.desc: A coin spun into the air: rising ticks as it turns, then a bright ping when it lands.

sounds.name: Combo Ping
sounds.desc: A short bright ping that rises one scale step per streak count, so a combo plays a rising tune. Chip makes it a square ping.

sounds.name: Countdown Beep
sounds.desc: The beep for 3, 2, 1 in a race or round start; turn Go on for the longer, higher start tone.

sounds.name: Door Open
sounds.desc: A latch clicks and a wooden hinge creaks open. Use a short length for a quick door, long for a spooky one.

sounds.name: Double Jump
sounds.desc: Two hops in a row, the second higher and quicker, for a mid-air jump. Chip is square; off is soft triangle.

sounds.name: Explosion Soft
sounds.desc: A big but friendly boom: a round blast with a pop on the front and crackles after. Cartoon, not harsh.

sounds.name: Footstep Hard
sounds.desc: A step on wood, tile or stone: a crisp tap with a knock under it. Use Vary for a walking rhythm.

sounds.name: Footstep Soft
sounds.desc: A quiet step on carpet, grass or sand. Use Vary so a walk never repeats exactly.

sounds.name: Gem Collect
sounds.desc: A crystalline two-strike ring for a gem or treasure: bright, glassy and a little longer than a coin.

sounds.name: Hammer Hit
sounds.desc: A hammer swung and landing on metal: air, then a clank with a thump under it.

sounds.name: Heal
sounds.desc: A warm rising swell with a soft glow on top, for health restored. Gentle by design; it can repeat.

sounds.name: Hit Heavy
sounds.desc: A heavy blow landing: deep sub, a body of rumble and a hard crack. For bosses, crits and slams.

sounds.name: Hit Light
sounds.desc: A quick, light strike landing: a short knock with a crisp crack. Small enough to chain in a fight.

sounds.name: Hurt
sounds.desc: A falling, wobbling "ow" with a crunch on the hit, for the player taking damage. Chip is square; off is a softer saw.

sounds.name: Jump
sounds.desc: The classic platformer hop: a quick rising sweep. Chip is a stepped square wave; off is a soft triangle.

sounds.name: Key Unlock
sounds.desc: A key jingles, turns and the lock gives: tiny metal ticks, a bolt clunk and a small ding.

sounds.name: Land
sounds.desc: A character landing after a jump or fall: a soft thump with a scuff of grit. Heavier settings hit longer.

sounds.name: Pickup Item
sounds.desc: A soft two-note blip for picking up an item. Quiet enough to repeat. Chip switches to square notes.

sounds.name: Power Up
sounds.desc: A quick rising scale that lands on a held note: you got stronger. Chip is square; off is soft triangle.

sounds.name: Punch
sounds.desc: A fist landing with a thump and a smack. Up to three in a flurry, each slightly softer.

sounds.name: Shield Up
sounds.desc: An energy field charging up: a humming rise that opens and locks in with a ping. For shields and buffs.

sounds.name: Sword Clash
sounds.desc: Steel meeting steel: a hard clang that rings, with an optional scrape. For parries and duels.

sounds.name: Sword Swing
sounds.desc: A blade cutting the air: a quick bright swish with a thin edge of steel. Sharper than the generic whoosh.

sounds.name: Referee Whistle
sounds.desc: A referee's whistle blast with a trilling pea and a card snap before it, or, switched to fizzle, a whistle that sags and runs out of air.

sounds.name: Whoosh
sounds.desc: Air rushing past: a swing, a dash, or a panel sliding across the screen.

sounds.name: Your Turn Jingle
sounds.desc: A bright arcade cue for the start of your turn: a swoop up into a quick arpeggio that lands on a held, shimmering octave.

sounds.name: Ability Trigger
sounds.desc: A short rising glide with a bright two-note ping: a creature ability switching on. Power fills it out with a low swell.

sounds.name: Drawn Arrow
sounds.desc: A bow drawn tight, an arrow whistling in and a thunk where it lands. No twang, dry, so it stacks under any element.

sounds.name: Crossing Shear
sounds.desc: Two crossing cuts that snap shut like shears, with a low chop where they meet. Short and dry, so it stacks under any element.

sounds.name: Claw Rake
sounds.desc: Up to five tearing swipes raked in a row, ending in a low thud. Dry and ragged, so it stacks under any element strike.

sounds.name: Spinning Crescents
sounds.desc: Up to three spinning blades whirring across in an arc, bursting into bright points at the end. Dry, so it stacks under any element.

sounds.name: Plunging Dive
sounds.desc: A fast plunging dive: a falling whistle, a dull landing and optional small airy taps after it. Dry, so it stacks under any element.

sounds.name: Fist Jab
sounds.desc: A single driving jab: a rush of air, a dull thud and a deep shockwave rolling out. Dry, so it stacks under any element strike.

sounds.name: Palm Slam
sounds.desc: A big flat hand coming down: a low swell, then a heavy landing with a deep sub and settling dust. No crack, no ring.

sounds.name: Rapid Volley
sounds.desc: A quick flurry of two to eight light blows ending on a heavier one. Dry and fast, for multi-hit attacks.

sounds.name: Coin Chain
sounds.desc: A row of coins settling one after another: each heads rings a little higher than the last, each tails lands with a dull clack. For a run of coin flips.

sounds.name: Counters
sounds.desc: Damage counters on a card: the discs click down one by one when placed, or lift off in a climbing run of soft plucks.

sounds.name: Energy Attach
sounds.desc: An energy card clicked on to a creature with a short chime. Each element has its own note; a special energy adds a gold ring.

sounds.name: Energy Break
sounds.desc: An energy card smashed: a swing of air, a clank and crack, a shower of tiny shards and a dull thud. For discarding an opponent's energy.

sounds.name: Evolve
sounds.desc: A creature changing form: a chord swelling up an octave like a column of light and landing on a bright ping. Off, it falls away.

sounds.name: Tether Hook
sounds.desc: A thrown line that hooks and reels something in: a fast zip out, a metal bite, a ratcheting pull and a soft landing. For dragging an opponent into play.

sounds.name: Knockout
sounds.desc: A creature going down: a short crack, a falling body and a slow deep sub, then a dull settle. Heavier than a hit, not louder.

sounds.name: Prize Taken
sounds.desc: A prize card lifted and turned over with a glint, then a bright two-note chime. For scoring a point by taking a prize.

sounds.name: Burned
sounds.desc: The burned condition: a flame catching with a few crackles when it lands, a quick sizzle at each turn checkup, and a hiss of steam when it goes out.

sounds.name: Confused
sounds.desc: The confused condition: a dizzy wobbling tone with twinkling stars when it lands, a dull bonk with two stars at each turn check, and two clear notes when the head clears.

sounds.name: Paralyzed
sounds.desc: The paralyzed condition: a stiff electric buzz with sharp zaps when it lands, a halting twitch at each turn checkup, and a loosening pop when it wears off.

sounds.name: Poisoned
sounds.desc: The poisoned condition: thick bubbles welling up when it lands, a pair of small pops at each turn checkup, and a clear rising run when it is cured.

sounds.name: Asleep
sounds.desc: The asleep condition: a falling lullaby when it lands, a slow snore at each turn checkup, and a sudden bright pop when the sleeper wakes.

sounds.name: Colorless Strike
sounds.desc: A plain strike: a clean rush of air swells in, then lands as a light, dry thump with a short pop and no tail. For a neutral attack.

sounds.name: Darkness Strike
sounds.desc: A darkness strike: a shadow smears downward with a faint wail, then lands as a deep, dull thud that throbs and fades. For a dark attack.

sounds.name: Dragon Strike
sounds.desc: A dragon strike: a growling rush rises with a low tone wavering, then lands as a rough falling roar and a breath of air. For a dragon attack.

sounds.name: Fairy Strike
sounds.desc: A fairy strike: a bright rush climbs with a shimmering pair of tones and glints, then lands as a soft chime and a twinkle. For a fairy attack.

sounds.name: Fighting Strike
sounds.desc: A fighting strike: air rushes in with a low tone rising, then lands as a deep thud with a slap and a puff of dust. For a punch or kick attack.

sounds.name: Fire Strike
sounds.desc: A fire strike: a flare rushes in with embers spitting, then lands as a low whoomph and a roar that crackles out. For a fire attack.

sounds.name: Grass Strike
sounds.desc: A grass strike: leaves rush in with a resonant rustle and a thin whistle, then land as a thwack and a scatter of leaves. For a plant attack.

sounds.name: Lightning Strike
sounds.desc: A lightning bolt: a charge builds with a fizzing hum and sparks, then lands as a bright crack, a sizzle and a low rumble. For an electric attack.

sounds.name: Metal Strike
sounds.desc: A metal strike: a bright rush with a thin singing tone, then lands as a steel clang with a hard tick and a short ring. For a steel attack.

sounds.name: Prism Strike
sounds.desc: A strike of three elements at once: fire, water and lightning rush in under one swell, then land crack, whoomph and splash with a glint. For a multi-element attack.

sounds.name: Psychic Strike
sounds.desc: A psychic strike: two wavering tones rise and beat against each other, then land as a falling pulse with a soft ping. For a mind attack.

sounds.name: Water Strike
sounds.desc: A water strike: a wave rushes in with bubbles popping, then splashes down with a thump, spray and falling droplets. For a water attack.

sounds.name: Weakness Bell
sounds.desc: Two quick bright bell strikes, the second an octave up: a hit that just did double damage. Thin and high, so it rides on top of a strike.

sounds.name: Chip Click
sounds.desc: A single poker chip clicked down: a crisp clay tick with a short ring and a hint of felt underneath.

sounds.name: Chip Stack
sounds.desc: Poker chips stacked one by one: uneven clay clicks climbing a little as the stack grows.

sounds.name: Chips Push All-In
sounds.desc: A pile of chips pushed forward for an all-in: a swelling rattle of clay clicks that ends in a thud and a few settling chips.

sounds.name: Card Deal
sounds.desc: One card dealt across the table: a flick off the deck, a soft skim over felt and a quiet landing.

sounds.name: Deal a Hand
sounds.desc: A hand dealt round the table, one card per seat, each landing a little differently.

sounds.name: Dice Roll
sounds.desc: A die thrown and tumbling to rest: bounces that close up and soften, then a last rocking tick.

sounds.name: Dice Shake
sounds.desc: Dice shaken in a cup: bursts of hard little clacks at each stroke, swelling and fading.

sounds.name: Card Discard
sounds.desc: A card tossed onto the discard pile: a flick, a short flight and a papery landing on the stack.

sounds.name: Card Draw
sounds.desc: A card drawn off the top of the deck: a rising paper rub that ends in a small snap as it comes free.

sounds.name: Fan Out Hand
sounds.desc: A hand of cards fanned open: a quick climbing ratchet of paper ticks over a breath of air.

sounds.name: Card Flick
sounds.desc: A playing card flicked off the deck, or a short fan of them dealt one after another.

sounds.name: Card Flip
sounds.desc: A card turned face up: a small scrape, a crisp snap at the turn and a light landing.

sounds.name: Hand Sweep
sounds.desc: A hand of cards swept back into the deck: a quick run of flicks under one swoosh, a dull bump, then a short riffle.

sounds.name: Card Land
sounds.desc: A played card arriving at its spot: a low thunk for the table, a small metal clink for an attachment, a dull pat for the discard pile.

sounds.name: Card Peek
sounds.desc: A quiet peek under the corner of a face-down card: a soft lift with a few creaks, a held pause, then the corner dropping back.

sounds.name: Piece Capture
sounds.desc: One wooden piece knocking another off its square: a sharp clack, then the lost piece skittering away.

sounds.name: Board Piece Move
sounds.desc: A wooden piece slid a little and set down on a board with a hollow, polite tok.

sounds.name: Card Place
sounds.desc: A single card set down on the table with a soft pat, felt-dark or wood-bright.

sounds.name: Card Reveal
sounds.desc: A card slapped down face up, five flavors: a crisp item, a warm supporter, a broad stadium, a clipped tool and a heavy ace with a flash.

sounds.name: Deck Riffle
sounds.desc: A deck riffled together: a quick ripple of paper ticks, never two quite alike.

sounds.name: Overhand Shuffle
sounds.desc: An overhand shuffle: separate short ripples of paper as chunks drop off the deck, then a pat to square it.

sounds.name: Card Slide
sounds.desc: A card slid across the felt: a soft breathy glide that falls away from you or rises toward you.

sounds.name: Card Tap
sounds.desc: A card turned sideways on the felt with a short paper drag and a soft pat, or, switched off, stood back upright with a lighter settle.

sounds.name: Turn Timer Tick
sounds.desc: A quiet wooden clock tick-tock for a turn timer, small enough to repeat every second.

sounds.name: Card Toss Spin
sounds.desc: A card flicked off and spinning through the air: a fluttering whir that slows, drifts across and ends in a skid and a soft landing.

sounds.name: Table Wash
sounds.desc: A deck mixed with both hands in wide circles on the table: overlapping paper sweeps in each ear and a scatter of fine grit.

sounds.name: Your Turn
sounds.desc: A gentle two-note mallet cue that says it is your move, with a soft tap of a card underneath.

sounds.name: Action Cast
sounds.desc: An action card played: a rising whoosh, a bright snap, a pulse sweeping the table and the card flicked onto the discard pile.

sounds.name: Trigger Bag Resolve
sounds.desc: Wooden chips knock out one at a time, climbing in pitch, each answered by a small glass ping. For triggered abilities resolving in order.

sounds.name: Banish Shatter
sounds.desc: A card cracking like glass and falling away: a quick crackle, a break that sinks in pitch, grey dust, tinkling shards, a low thump.

sounds.name: Banner Raise
sounds.desc: A wide location card sliding in on a low sweep, a banner unrolling in two cloth flaps and a small gold chime for its lore.

sounds.name: Card Land
sounds.desc: A card landing damp with a soft pat, beads of ink falling from it, then a warm shimmer opening as it dries. For playing a character.

sounds.name: Chorus Cast
sounds.desc: A character singing a song: a short rising phrase of soft "ah" voices that ends in a glass bell as the song lights up.

sounds.name: Chorus Sum
sounds.desc: Singers joining one after another: each card adds a pip and a voice to a growing chord, closed by a bright bell when it adds up.

sounds.name: Duel Clash
sounds.desc: One card lunging at another: a rush, a heavy clunk with a short cold ring, then two dry damage ticks at once, one on each side.

sounds.name: Dash Tether
sounds.desc: A fast rising rush into a snap, then a tight string twang: a dash pulled up short by a tether. For Rush and Reckless.

sounds.name: Exert Tilt
sounds.desc: A card turned on its side to act, a dimming slide and a low knock, or stood back up, a brightening slide and a thin glass tip.

sounds.name: Guard Block
sounds.desc: A solid wooden thud with a short metal ring: a blow stopped by a guard. For a Bodyguard stepping in to take an attack.

sounds.name: Hunt Chain
sounds.desc: A ping and quickening ticks lock on to one target, then challengers clash into it one after another, each a step higher, until it shatters.

sounds.name: Blue Ink
sounds.desc: The Blue ink signature: a marimba arpeggio ticks along with clockwork and lands on a high note, then the gears slow. For planning and building up ink.

sounds.name: Gold Ink
sounds.desc: The Gold ink signature: three soft plucks climb into a warm pair of bells that glow and ring out. For supportive, kind cards.

sounds.name: Green Ink
sounds.desc: The Green ink signature: three dry plucked notes with leafy swishes land in a finger snap and a rustle of leaves. For tricky cards.

sounds.name: Grey Ink
sounds.desc: The Grey ink signature: three small rivet tinks rise into an anvil clang over a low thud. For armored, resistant cards.

sounds.name: Red Ink
sounds.desc: The Red ink signature: a charging riser slams into a brassy stab with a thump and a crack, and a dash trail fades behind. For fast, bold cards.

sounds.name: Violet Ink
sounds.desc: The Violet ink signature: a backwards shimmer swirls upward into a glassy bell that rings with a faint glide back down. For magic and returns.

sounds.name: Ladder Climb
sounds.desc: A chain of upgrades: each form slides on with a soft landing and a step higher, the tone thickening, until the last arrives free with gold chimes.

sounds.name: Lend Hop
sounds.desc: Two soft mallet blips, the second higher: strength hopping from one card to another. For Support.

sounds.name: Lore Gain
sounds.desc: A small gold star arcing up and landing as a rising run of glass chimes, one more note for each point of lore gained.

sounds.name: Lore Tick
sounds.desc: A tiny gold glass tick for one point of lore on the meter. Quiet and quick, meant to repeat; raise the pitch as the meter fills.

sounds.name: Move to Location
sounds.desc: A card hops, slides across a wide location card and settles with a soft landing tick and a faint ring. For moving a character to a location.

sounds.name: Pump and Snipe
sounds.desc: A bonus hops to an ally, its strength ticks upward in quick blips, then a twanging shot lands and the target shatters.

sounds.name: Quest Pull
sounds.desc: A gentle rising pull, like a tether tugging, ending in a small golden chime. For Adventurous, a card drawn to quest.

sounds.name: Ready Sweep
sounds.desc: A whole row of cards standing up in a rising run of soft wooden ticks as a band of light sweeps across, left to right.

sounds.name: Resist Plink
sounds.desc: A bright metal tink or two off armor, a small step down, then one dry tick: damage shaved down. For Resist.

sounds.name: Shift Swell
sounds.desc: One card sliding over another: a reedy swell that rises a fifth, then a thud and a bright glass overtone as it lands.

sounds.name: Slip By
sounds.desc: A thin, fluttering swish that slides past and fades: an attack missing its mark. For Evasive.

sounds.name: Slip and Draw
sounds.desc: Two airy attackers sweep past a defender that swings and misses, a swirl bounces it away, small gold chimes pay out and cards flick off the deck.

sounds.name: Song Rush
sounds.desc: Two cheap singers tilt and trade a fast, wordless "ahh" run up the scale, then the song fires for free in a bright flare of gold chimes.

sounds.name: Spike Pump
sounds.desc: A quick rising run of bright notes ending in a crack: strength pumped up as the attack begins. For Challenger.

sounds.name: Surge Drop
sounds.desc: Ink jumps ahead of the curve: quick drips, a swelling rise and a big card landing early with a low ring and a flash of gold.

sounds.name: Sweep Clear
sounds.desc: A board wipe: cards stack up quietly, a low swell rolls across the table and crashes, and the characters on the far side break and fall away.

sounds.name: Ink Token Mint
sounds.desc: A single-use ink token appearing: a small bloop of ink and one bright coin-like tink that chirps upward. For minting a token worth one ink.

sounds.name: Ink Token Pop
sounds.desc: A single-use ink token spent: a soft falling pop, a glassy tick and a few small crumbs of glass tumbling away. For paying one ink once.

sounds.name: Under Slide
sounds.desc: Ink dripping to pay, then a card sliding softly under another and settling with a small click. For Boost.

sounds.name: Vanish Dust
sounds.desc: A tiny lock-on tick, then a card dissolving into falling, glittering dust. For Vanish.

sounds.name: Victory Burst
sounds.desc: The win: a quick rising run of glass bells that opens into a full chord, a burst of sparkle and a warm swell underneath.

sounds.name: Ward Bubble
sounds.desc: A glassy bubble forming and ringing, then a tink and a tiny crackle as something bounces off and shatters. For Ward.

sounds.name: Well Drip
sounds.desc: A bead of ink falling into a dark well: a soft glassy plink, a low bubble in the pool and two ripples. For inking a card.

sounds.name: Wide Payoff
sounds.desc: A bonus pays off: three soft tilts, a muted landing and a shimmer, then small gold glass chimes climb and stack, one per lore point scored.

sounds.name: Arcane Charge
sounds.desc: Energy gathering: a glowing swell climbs in pitch with shimmering overtones and ends in a ready ping.

sounds.name: Curse Hex
sounds.desc: A sinister low toll with a sour interval, a sagging drone and creeping whispers. For debuffs and dark spells.

sounds.name: Enchant
sounds.desc: A harp-like run of plucked notes over a glowing pad, closing on a bell. For enchanting an item.

sounds.name: Fire Spell
sounds.desc: A rushing fireball: a warm thump at the cast, a roar that swells and fades, and crackling embers.

sounds.name: Healing Shimmer
sounds.desc: A warm chord that swells and blooms with a few falling sparkles. For healing, a blessing or a buff.

sounds.name: Ice Spell
sounds.desc: A crystalline freeze: a glassy ring over a frosty hiss, then icy shards tinkling away downward.

sounds.name: Lightning Bolt
sounds.desc: A bright crack of electricity that forks into crackling arcs and rolls away as low thunder.

sounds.name: Portal Open
sounds.desc: A swirling gateway tears open: a resonant vortex whirls up, then a deep shimmering chord settles.

sounds.name: Potion Bubble
sounds.desc: A bubbling cauldron of glassy bloops with a faint magical glimmer. For potions, brewing and alchemy.

sounds.name: Magic Sparkle
sounds.desc: A rising twinkle of bright notes over a breath of shimmer, with a little room around it.

sounds.name: Spell Cast
sounds.desc: Magic gathered and let go: a quick rising swirl, then a bright bell bloom opening in a soft room.

sounds.name: Teleport
sounds.desc: A vanishing rush upward, a beat of silence, then a soft bell where you reappear.

sounds.name: Arc Zap
sounds.desc: A short electric arc: a snap, a rough flickering buzz and a spit of crackle. For an electric border lighting up, a plasma effect or a spark between two things.

sounds.name: Circuit Pulse
sounds.desc: A bright chirp zips along a circuit trace, kicking up a notch at each corner, and lights a node at the end with a glassy ring. For energy flowing through a circuit diagram.

sounds.name: Confetti Pop
sounds.desc: A hollow party-popper pop followed by a thinning shower of paper flutters and a few bright glints. For celebrations, wins and milestones.

sounds.name: CRT Power
sounds.desc: An old tube screen turning on with a thump and a climbing whine, or off with a collapse to a single dot. For retro boot screens and screen-off effects.

sounds.name: Identity Disc
sounds.desc: A spinning disc is thrown, whirs away with a falling pitch, curves back rising and is caught with a clack. For a projectile that returns, like a boomerang.

sounds.name: Firework
sounds.desc: A shell whistles up, bursts with a flash and a thump, then crackles and glitters as the embers fall. For celebrations and finales.

sounds.name: Foil Sheen
sounds.desc: A bright hollow sweep with a breath of air and a few tiny glints, like light sliding across foil. For a hover, a tilt or a shiny card being revealed.

sounds.name: Gear Whir
sounds.desc: A little set of gears spinning up and winding down: meshing ticks over a rising and falling servo whine. For settings cogs, machinery and mechanical loaders.

sounds.name: Glitch Burst
sounds.desc: A digital hiccup: a tiny chirp stuck on repeat, then another, smeared left and right and crushed to grit. For a screen glitching or an image corrupting.

sounds.name: Grid Sweep
sounds.desc: Deep sub pulses under a hollow rising wash that ends on a glass ping at the horizon. For a neon grid scrolling into view or a retro-futuristic scene opening.

sounds.name: Hologram On
sounds.desc: A shimmering sweep that stutters into a glassy chord as a projection appears, or breaks up and drifts away as it switches off. For a hologram or a screen image materializing.

sounds.name: Liquid Drip
sounds.desc: A single drop plinks into a pool and ripple rings spread out behind it. Thin for water, thick for wax or syrup. For liquid loaders, ripples and dripping effects.

sounds.name: Blob Morph
sounds.desc: A gooey wobbling tone that swells up (or shrinks back down) as a shape morphs, with a few soft bloops along the way.

sounds.name: Neon Strike
sounds.desc: A neon sign or bad bulb stuttering on: rough buzzing strikes that grow longer, then a steady electric hum. For a sign switching on or a failing light.

sounds.name: Rocket Launch
sounds.desc: Ignition, a deep rumble and a roar that opens up as a rocket climbs away and fades. For launches, deploys and blast-offs.

sounds.name: Scramble Decode
sounds.desc: A shower of random blips that narrows onto one note and locks in with a glassy ring. For text unscrambling, a redaction lifting or a code being cracked.

sounds.name: Glass Shatter
sounds.desc: A sharp crack and a burst of splinters, then shards tinkling to the floor. For breaking glass, cracked screens and things smashed apart.

sounds.name: Signal Tear
sounds.desc: A worn tape losing tracking: the tone sags and wobbles, noise bands race down the screen, then it locks back. For old TVs, VHS and a failing signal.

sounds.name: Vortex Spiral
sounds.desc: Air circling faster and faster around you as the pitch climbs, or falls on the way in. For spiral transitions, vortex pulls and tunnel zooms.

sounds.name: Soft Alert Siren
sounds.desc: A gentle two-tone siren that swoops between notes: a warning that gets attention without startling.

sounds.name: Blaster Bolt
sounds.desc: A heavy plasma shot: a gritty falling snarl with a bright crack on top and a thump underneath.

sounds.name: Data Stream
sounds.desc: A rapid patter of tiny bitcrushed ticks and chirps, like data pouring through a channel.

sounds.name: Facility Klaxon
sounds.desc: A growling industrial alarm horn in three blasts: a steady buzzing tone with a mechanical rattle, ringing in a concrete hall. For lockdowns, breaches and red alerts.

sounds.name: Hologram Flicker
sounds.desc: A glassy digital tone that stutters and drops out as a projection flickers, with static in the gaps.

sounds.name: Laser Zap
sounds.desc: A bright falling pew for a laser shot. Fire it once, or in a quick burst of up to four.

sounds.name: Power Down
sounds.desc: A machine spinning down: a falling whine closes under a slowing patter of ticks and ends in a soft clunk.

sounds.name: Power Up
sounds.desc: A machine spinning up: accelerating ticks climb into a rising whine that locks on at full power.

sounds.name: Robot Chirp
sounds.desc: A quick burst of FM chirps that swoop up and down like a small, expressive droid.

sounds.name: Scanner Sweep
sounds.desc: A narrow beam sweeping up and back with a wobble, ending on a two-blip confirm.

sounds.name: Shield Hum
sounds.desc: A throbbing energy hum that swells in as a shield powers up, then settles into a slow pulse.

sounds.name: Terminal Blip
sounds.desc: A quick run of bitcrushed computer beeps, like a console printing a readout or acknowledging a command.

sounds.name: Warp Jump
sounds.desc: An engine whine winds up, then the ship leaps: a stretched streak and a deep thump as it vanishes.

sounds.name: Abyss Drone
sounds.desc: A very low bowed drone with a cold shimmer far above it, swelling and sinking like the bottom of a well. For a menu that broods, a descent into the dark or a quiet threat under a scene.

sounds.name: Knell
sounds.desc: One small, dark bell stroke with a mournful minor-third ring and a short room. For a notification, reminder or message that is softer than an alarm.

sounds.name: Bowed Metal
sounds.desc: A slow, singing swell of bowed metal, shimmering and beating against itself. For something wrong in the room, a cold ghostly presence or an unearthly menu.

sounds.name: Candle Flicker
sounds.desc: A tiny soft breath of flame with a small flutter, very quiet. For hovering over a control or showing a tooltip in a candlelit interface.

sounds.name: Cathedral Choir
sounds.desc: A hushed choir swelling on a minor chord under a stone vault, the vowel slowly opening. For a gothic menu, a crypt or a solemn reveal.

sounds.name: Cello Drone
sounds.desc: Low cellos holding a bare fifth, swelling in and out of the dark. For a quiet threat, a long walk down a corridor, or a menu that broods.

sounds.name: Cello Stab
sounds.desc: A short, low, clashing cello stab with the bow digging in. For a rejected action, an error or a warning in a tense interface.

sounds.name: Choir Amen
sounds.desc: A short, soft two-chord choir cadence that settles like an amen. For a saved or completed action, an achievement, or a finished load in a gothic interface.

sounds.name: Crypt Door
sounds.desc: A heavy stone slab sliding aside with a low grind and settling with a soft thud, or sliding shut. For opening and closing panels and dialogs, and for moving between screens.

sounds.name: Doom Braam
sounds.desc: A colossal low blast that swells into a roar and fades in a huge hall. For a title reveal, a monster rising or the moment a plan collapses.

sounds.name: Doom Drum
sounds.desc: A single enormous drum blow that booms through a hall. For a boss entrance, a title card or the moment everything goes wrong.

sounds.name: Door Creak
sounds.desc: A long, wandering creak of an old wooden door on dry hinges, optionally ending in a soft thud as it shuts. For opening a door into the dark.

sounds.name: Dread Descent
sounds.desc: A tone that keeps sinking and never reaches the bottom: pure, endless dread. For a fall into the dark, a nightmare or a slow loss of control.

sounds.name: Funeral Bell
sounds.desc: A great low church bell tolling slowly, its hum lingering after each stroke. For a funeral, a death, a game over or the dread of a clock striking an hour.

sounds.name: Haunted Corridor
sounds.desc: Wind drifting down a long empty hall, a creaking board and faint whispers somewhere behind you. For a haunted house, a walk through a ruin or a menu that watches back.

sounds.name: Heartbeat in the Dark
sounds.desc: A muffled heartbeat thudding over a low dread drone. Slow is held-breath stillness, fast is panic. For hiding, a monster nearby or a low-health warning.

sounds.name: Horror Strings
sounds.desc: A shrieking cluster of high strings that slides upward and hangs in the air. For a nightmare, a creature in the doorway or a plan going wrong.

sounds.name: Jump Scare
sounds.desc: An instant, violent stab of strings and drum with a ringing tail. For something leaping out of the dark or a sudden shock.

sounds.name: Monk Chant
sounds.desc: Low male voices chant a slow minor phrase over a held drone in a stone chapel. For a ritual, a crypt or the reveal of something old.

sounds.name: Music Box
sounds.desc: A small music box plays a faltering minor-key tune, slightly sour, slowing and sagging as its spring runs out. For a haunted nursery or a quiet scare.

sounds.name: Organ Minor Swell
sounds.desc: A pipe organ swelling on a minor chord over a deep pedal note. For a gothic title, a haunted mansion or a dramatic reveal.

sounds.name: Slow Clock
sounds.desc: An old grandfather clock ticking slowly and heavily in an empty room, tick then lower tock, the wooden case humming. For waiting, a countdown or dread.

sounds.name: Stone Click
sounds.desc: A dull tick on old stone with a low knock under it, never bright. For buttons and selections in a dark, gothic interface.

sounds.name: Sub Drop
sounds.desc: A deep boom that falls away beneath you, felt more than heard. For a floor giving way, a transition or the weight of bad news.

sounds.name: Tense Ostinato
sounds.desc: A driving low cello pulse of short bowed notes, 4 beats long: re-trigger every 2 s at the default tempo (240 / bpm seconds). For a chase or a countdown.

sounds.name: Timpani Roll
sounds.desc: A drum roll that builds from a murmur to a thundering final blow. For the moment before a reveal, a countdown to doom or a boss about to appear.

sounds.name: Whisper Swarm
sounds.desc: A crowd of unintelligible whispers close around you from every side, rising and fading. For a haunted room, a bad idea or something watching.

sounds.name: Aurora Pad
sounds.desc: A slow, wide, glowing chord that swells and sways like curtains of light, with a thin glitter above. A dreamy bed for a night sky.

sounds.name: Cave Drips
sounds.desc: Slow drips falling in a damp stone chamber, each one ringing in the echo, over a low draft of air.

sounds.name: Distant Thunder
sounds.desc: A storm miles away: a muffled crack and a long low rumble that rolls and fades out.

sounds.name: Fire Crackle
sounds.desc: A hearth or campfire: a soft roar of flame with random snaps, pops and the odd log settling.

sounds.name: Forest Birds
sounds.desc: Morning birdsong in the trees: tweets, trills and whistles from near and far over a faint breeze.

sounds.name: Grid Hum
sounds.desc: The clean electric hum of a vast digital grid: a pure throbbing tone with a glassy sheen and tiny data ticks crossing it. For cyber scenes.

sounds.name: Lava Bubbles
sounds.desc: Thick warm bubbles rising slowly and popping softly over a low simmer of heat, like a lava lamp. Fades in and out.

sounds.name: Night Crickets
sounds.desc: A warm summer night: a few crickets chirping in runs from different places in the dark, over cool still air.

sounds.name: Ocean Surf
sounds.desc: Waves building and breaking on a beach, each with a hiss of foam, over a low swell. Fades in and out.

sounds.name: Rain
sounds.desc: Rain on leaves and puddles, from a drizzle to a steady downpour. Fades in and out.

sounds.name: Room Tone Hum
sounds.desc: A quiet indoor bed: electrical hum with its buzzing harmonics over a breath of ventilation hiss.

sounds.name: Sand Pour
sounds.desc: Fine sand pouring in a soft steady hiss, thinning to a last few grains and a quiet settle. Good under an hourglass or a timer running down.

sounds.name: Snow Hush
sounds.desc: Snow falling on a windless night: a soft muffled hush, clumps sliding off branches and faint ice glints. A calm winter-scene bed.

sounds.name: Space Drone
sounds.desc: A slow, deep drone for a ship or a void: a dark pad that opens up, with a faint shimmer far above.

sounds.name: Starfield Pad
sounds.desc: A thin airy pad under a sky of stars: soft twinkling notes ring out across a wide, quiet field. For space and night scenes.

sounds.name: Storm Roar
sounds.desc: Being inside a big storm: a deep wide roar of wind and sheeting rain with a low wail running through it. For a gale, tornado or downpour.

sounds.name: Synthwave Drive
sounds.desc: A night drive as a texture: a steady bass pulse, a slow glowing chord and the rush of the road, with no tune. For retro neon scenes.

sounds.name: Wind Gusts
sounds.desc: An open-air wind bed: steady air with slow gusts rolling through and a faint whistle. Fades in and out.

sounds.name: Zen Breath
sounds.desc: A slow breath in and out over the soft wobbling hum of a singing bowl. For focus, calm and winding down.

sounds.name: Alert Sting
sounds.desc: Short minor stabs and a long tense chord with a sub thump, for danger, a boss entrance or a hard warning.

sounds.name: Defeat Jingle
sounds.desc: A falling four-note sad-brass wah for a lost round: three short steps down and one long sagging note.

sounds.name: Short Fanfare
sounds.desc: Three stabs and a long chord on synth brass: an announcement or a proud arrival in two seconds.

sounds.name: Intro Logo Sting
sounds.desc: A rising sweep that opens into a warm, ringing major-seventh chord with a glint on top. A calm logo reveal.

sounds.name: Level Complete
sounds.desc: A warm plucked arpeggio climbing into a ringing bell chord. For finishing a stage, not a whole game.

sounds.name: Menu Confirm Melody
sounds.desc: Two to four quick rising notes with an echo, for pressing Start or confirming a menu choice.

sounds.name: Mystery Sting
sounds.desc: Two hanging bell tones a tritone apart over a dark swell. For a clue, a twist or a door that should not open.

sounds.name: Ta-da
sounds.desc: A cheerful two-chord reveal: a quick staccato hit and a bright held chord with a sparkle on top.

sounds.name: Victory Jingle
sounds.desc: A chiptune win: a quick rising arpeggio into a held major chord. Bright, short and proud.

sounds.name: Access Denied
sounds.desc: A synthesized announcer says "Access denied." with a firm falling close: for a locked door, a wrong password, a refused action.

sounds.name: Access Granted
sounds.desc: A synthesized announcer says "Access granted." for an unlocked door, an accepted password or an approved request.

sounds.name: Robot Beep Babble
sounds.desc: Square-wave talk beeps on a pentatonic scale, a letter at a time: a robot or an 8-bit hero talking in a text box.

sounds.name: Cute Babble
sounds.desc: Animalese-style talk: a high, quick blip for every letter of "Oh, hi there! Are you new in town?", with a question lilt at the end.

sounds.name: Elder Babble
sounds.desc: Slow, breathy, trembling talk syllables with a little room: a wise elder telling an old story.

sounds.name: Gruff Babble
sounds.desc: Low, slow, rough talk blips, a syllable at a time: a grumpy shopkeeper or a guard brushing you off.

sounds.name: Sprite Babble
sounds.desc: A tiny, very fast, very high chatter: a fairy or a sprite talking, a blip per letter.

sounds.name: Containment Breach
sounds.desc: A facility PA voice says "Containment breach. Evacuate the facility." To play with scifi-facility-klaxon in a lockdown.

sounds.name: Countdown
sounds.desc: A synthesized announcer counts down "Three. Two. One." on a steady beat, for a launch, a race start or a timer.

sounds.name: Game Over
sounds.desc: A deep robot voice says "Game over." with a slow falling close, for the end of a run.

sounds.name: Level Complete
sounds.desc: A synthesized announcer says "Level complete." at the end of a stage.

sounds.name: Mission Complete
sounds.desc: A synthesized announcer says "Mission complete." when an objective is done.

sounds.name: Ready Go
sounds.desc: A synthesized announcer says "Ready... go!" with a held breath between the words: the start of a round or a race.

sounds.name: Retro Computer
sounds.desc: A flat, buzzy home computer voice through an 8-bit converter says "Greetings, user. Loading program. Please wait."

sounds.name: Robot Affirmative
sounds.desc: A deep metallic robot says "Affirmative. Command accepted." for a confirmed order.

sounds.name: Robot Processing
sounds.desc: A small bright robot says "Beep boop. Processing request." in a tin-box voice: a helper bot thinking.

sounds.name: System Online
sounds.desc: A synthesized announcer says "System online." for a boot, a power-up or a reconnect.

sounds.name: Warning
sounds.desc: A synthesized announcer says "Warning." through a PA horn into a hall: the classic computer voice of an alert.

sounds.name: Whisper Behind You
sounds.desc: A breathy whisper says "Behind you..." close to the ear: a horror sting.

sounds.name: Your Turn Call
sounds.desc: A synthesized announcer says "Your turn." when control passes to the player: a turn-based game, a card table, a shared session.

themes.name: Soft UI
themes.desc: Quiet, rounded feedback for productivity apps: soft ticks, a gentle chime, a low buzz.

themes.name: 8-bit
themes.desc: Chiptune: square and triangle beeps, bitcrushed blips and arpeggio jingles in C major.

themes.name: Arcade
themes.desc: Punchy, bright game feedback and big wins: sharp clicks, ringing pings, brass fanfares, a real boom.

themes.name: Dread
themes.desc: Strings, heartbeat and sub hits for horror games and anything that should feel watched: dull, close small sounds and a horror score for the big ones.

themes.name: Fantasy
themes.desc: Spells, chimes and parchment for game menus and role-playing games: harps, bells, a quill and a fireball.

themes.name: Glass
themes.desc: Bright, bell-like and airy: struck-glass ticks, high chimes and sparkle. Clean and a little cold.

themes.name: Gothic
themes.desc: Organ, choir, bells and stone for dark fantasy, cathedrals and candlelit menus: elegant and brooding, never cheap horror.

themes.name: Mechanical
themes.desc: Switches, ratchets, relays and a typewriter bell: clicky, dry and precise.

themes.name: Sci-fi Console
themes.desc: Terminal blips, scanner sweeps and synthetic confirmations: bitcrushed beeps and clean digital tones.

themes.name: Wood and Paper
themes.desc: Warm, tactile and organic: wood knocks, cards and paper, a ticking clock, a creaking drawer.
